name: Try! (Imadesho!)
source:
12th-grade students Tani (who likes boys) and Kakimoto (who does not) have been friends since they started high school. One day, though, Kakimoto finds out that Tani has a crush on him. Tani braces himself for the worst... but to his surprise, Kakimoto rather flippantly suggests that they try dating. "May as well give the whole 'gay' thing a shot, y'know?"

...Um, if you say so??

[From [url=https://stellarcanopy.ca/translate/imadesho.html]Stellar Canopy[/url]]
translation:
12年级学生塔尼（喜欢男孩）和柿本（不喜欢男孩）从高中开始就是朋友。然而有一天，柿本发现谷喜欢他。谷做好了最坏的打算……但令他惊讶的是，柿本相当轻率地建议他们尝试约会。“不妨尝试一下整个‘同性恋’的事情，你知道吗？”

……呃，如果你这么说的话？

[来自[url=https://stellarcanopy.ca/translate/imadesho.html]Stellar Canopy[/url]]
